method: Targeted web searches (search engine results; publisher/indexer pages used for verification; page fetch of publisher sites blocked by environment). Records = distinct scholarly works (journal articles, books, proceedings, theses, chapters) appearing in results of the gap-driven queries. News, blogs, vendor pages and encyclopedia entries were not counted as records.
inclusion_criteria: peer-reviewed article, recognized scholarly book, or proceedings from an established publisher
bibliographic identity confirmed on a publisher or indexing page
directly supports a specific claim/gap in the thesis
not redundant with a baseline source
queries: Q1 DeLone & McLean IS success model original (Ch2 §2-7-3 names the model)
Q2 interview sample size / saturation (Ch3 §3-7-2 saturation at 25 interviews)
Q4 security vs usability of crypto for users (finding T22)
Q5 cryptocurrency and sanctions / Iran (Ch1 problem statement; finding N21)
Q6 Iran internet shutdown economic impact (finding N31)
Q7 Generation Z fintech expectations (finding U21)
Q9-Q13 follow-up detail searches for candidates (trust in FinTech; value-based adoption; Nobitex/Iran market; Gen Z peer-reviewed)
Q14 MVP origin (Ch2 §2-5-2 definition; finding O25)
Q15 agile methods review (Ch2 §2-5-2; finding O21)
